heroSubtitle: To the most wonderful sister in the world ❤️

letter.heading: Happy Raksha Bandhan to my lifelong crime partner! 🪔❤️
bodyParagraphs: From fighting over the TV remote to secretly sharing midnight treats, having you as my sister is the greatest blessing in my life.
Thank you for always listening to my nonsense, guiding me when I needed advice, and having my back in every situation.
On this sacred day of Raksha Bandhan, I promise to always stand by you, protect you, annoy you forever, and make you proud!
